trajectory.content:
Implemented the `solve.cu` performance fix.

Key changes:
- Replaced the O(N×M) brute-force nearest-neighbor search with traversal of the supplied GPU KD-tree.
- Removed all batch-wise kernel launches and per-batch `cudaDeviceSynchronize()` calls.
- Eliminated the intermediate device-to-host centroid copy and stream synchronization.
- Accumulated raw moments on GPU and computed centered covariance in a final GPU kernel.
- Retained persistent scratch allocation, so allocation happens only once ra
